purpose: Reusable visual object bible; world_reference points to authoritative world lore.

objects.name: Magneton Type A
objects.description: Bronze-like metal. Very durable

objects.name: Magneton Type B
objects.description: Glowing green in both polarities. Found in opposite magnetic polarities

objects.name: Magneton Type C
objects.description: Silvery metal. Most malleable of the Magneton types; Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons; Can drift along magnetic fields

objects.name: Mole
objects.description: Squat mining tug with detachable deep ore cassette, loading arms, and forward drill. Close-site positioning
constraints: Rigid mechanical metal Zeppelin design; no sailboats or canvas sails.

objects.name: Needle
objects.description: Light teardrop commuter hull, compact cockpit, and articulated engine outriggers. Very high mobility
constraints: Rigid mechanical metal Zeppelin design; no sailboats or canvas sails.

objects.name: Kestrel
objects.description: Small swept open-deck commuter with glass forward cabin, boarding deck, and hull-edge magnetic rings. High mobility
constraints: Rigid mechanical metal Zeppelin design; no sailboats or canvas sails.

objects.name: Caravan
objects.description: Large twin parallel Zeppelin hulls connected by cargo bridges, freight modules and passenger space. Cumbersome turns
constraints: Rigid mechanical metal Zeppelin design; no sailboats or canvas sails.

objects.name: Terrace
objects.description: Broad trader with terraced passenger decks, forward saloon, enclosed freight holds, and raised aft bridge. Slow and cumbersome
constraints: Rigid mechanical metal Zeppelin design; no sailboats or canvas sails.

objects.name: Bastion
objects.description: Broad armoured three-keel fortress with command citadel, gun decks, and large magnetic engines. Limited maneuverability
constraints: Rigid mechanical metal Zeppelin design; no sailboats or canvas sails.

objects.name: Magnetic lance
objects.description: Condenses magnetic fields and fires the concentrated energy like a cannon.

objects.name: Field broadsword
objects.description: Condenses magnetic fields into a larger blade capable of cutting through a ship’s hull.

objects.name: Twin wind swords
objects.description: A pair of wind-like swords that lets the wielder fly like a bird.

objects.name: Shield war hammer
objects.description: Creates its own magnetic field when slammed down, forming a shield against Tesla guns.

objects.name: Magnetic scythe
objects.description: Lets the wielder jump between two concentrated points of magnetic energy.

objects.name: Tesla gun
objects.description: Copper-coiled fictional electrical rifle with green-lit charge. Cannot pierce silver Type C.

objects.name: Magneton motor
objects.description: Opposite-polarity glowing GREEN Type B cores in a mechanical motor; powers the floating cities and ships. Both polarities are GREEN.

objects.name: Veymarch infantry kit
objects.description: BRONZE armour over crimson cloth and red capes; green Tesla rifles. Ordinary troops are never silver Type C.

objects.name: Auric Reach town guard kit
objects.description: Navy-and-gold cloth, BRASS helmets, green Tesla guns. No silver armour.

objects.name: Argonaut
objects.description: Rovan’s ONE Bastion-derived Argonaut, refitted with his newfound wealth. UNIQUE silhouette: elongated rigid bronze Zeppelin central hull, two shorter side gun hulls, wedge-shaped armoured ram prow and reinforced lower keel; crimson lacquer side armour between bronze ribs, low protected command citadel, TWO exposed green magnetic stabiliser rings near the stern, FOUR articulated bronze vectoring thruster pods with green Type B glow, rebuilt gun positions. Veymarch SILVER broken shield/eight-point star on crimson banners. Workshop-built industrial machinery, not ornate fantasy gold or a generic round-nosed Bastion.
constraints: Exactly one Argonaut. No extra friendly capital ship. Do not add wooden hulls, sails, balloons or other vessels from references.
Same ship after a refit, never an additional capital ship.
All hull armour is bronze Type A; machinery is green Type B. No silver Type C hull or invulnerability.
Canonical Argonaut refit design controls hull geometry; older generic Bastion art supplies ancestry only.
Keep the wedge prow, crimson side armour, paired green stern stabiliser rings and vectoring pods recognisable in every new exterior view.
